name: Abraham Azulai
contribution: A Kabbalistic author and commentator born in Fez, Morocco.

checks.lead: Abraham ben Mordecai Azulai (c. 1570–1643) (Hebrew: אברהם בן מרדכי אזולאי) was a Kabbalistic author and commentator born in Fez, Morocco. In 1599 he moved to Ottoman Palestine and settled in Hebron.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
